cohort: 90 babies between 6 months and 2 years of age with ARI and 90 babies without ARI.
finding: Malnourished babies are more prone to ARI.
mod_finding: Caesarean birth was one of the factors compared between babies with and without ARI, and it reached statistical significance (p<0.001).
birth_weight: Measured and compared between groups (mean weight at birth)
